verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports scanning multiple languages via registry rulesets and dependency/SCA scanning across package ecosystems (docs-29, docs-13, comm-5 showing multi-language parsing at scale), with hands-on probe confirming CLI scans work offline without login. However, community evidence flags real coverage/accuracy gaps (TS parser errors on valid syntax, performance issues at scale, easily bypassed rules), indicating coverage is broad but not uniformly robust across all ecosystems.
